canonical_name: Picard-Lindelof theorem (classical local ODE existence-uniqueness family)
literal_source_claim_en: Existence and uniqueness of ODE solutions.
statement_blocker: The catalog does not fix the state space, autonomous or time-dependent field, domain, continuity and Lipschitz hypotheses, quantitative or existential interval, derivative and solution encoding, or uniqueness class. Pinned mathlib splits existence and uniqueness across materially different declarations. Selecting and composing one variant at intake would invent missing mathematics and may duplicate THM-M-1331.
domain_and_universes: Prospective real time and a source-selected scalar, finite-dimensional, or complete normed real vector space E; a field f depending on time and state or its autonomous specialization; curves Real -> E; Prop in universe 0. Exact instances and domains remain open.
conclusion: Prospective conclusion: a solution through prescribed initial data exists on a nontrivial local interval and is unique in a source-selected class. Exact interval, derivative, range, and equality predicates remain open.
